title: At the bus stop
goal: Name places and dishes with two-noun compounds, and put case endings on them.

intro.text: Put two nouns together to name a kind of thing: the first stays bare, the second takes **its**, `-(s)Y`: *awtobus duralgasy*, a bus stop; *türkmen halysy*, a Turkmen carpet. A case ending follows **its**, with *n*: *duralgasynda*, at the stop.

vocab.en: number (of a phone, a room, a bus)

exercises.question: How do you say **a bus stop**?

why.1: In a compound the second noun needs **its**: *duralgasy*.
why.2: The first noun takes no ending, and the second needs **its**: *awtobus duralgasy*.
why.3: The first noun stays as it is: *awtobus*, not *awtobusy*.

exercises.explain: *awtobus* + *duralga* + *-sy*: a stop of the bus kind.

exercises.en: The museum is on Magtymguly Street.

reject.why: The street needs **its** before the case ending: *köçe* + *-si* + *n* + *-de* = *köçesinde*.
After **its**, a case ending takes *n* first: *köçesinde*.
In a compound the second noun needs **its**: *awtobus duralgasy*.

accept: The airport is far from the city centre.
The airport is far from the city center.
The airport is far from the town [centre|center].
The airport is far from [downtown|the centre of town|the center of town|the centre of the city|the center of the city].

exercises.gloss: at the stop (as in: awtobus duralgasynda, at the bus stop)

exercises.prompt: I'm waiting at the bus stop.

reject.why: Keep **its** in the compound before the case ending: *duralgasynda*.

exercises.question: How do you ask **Is there chicken soup?**

why.2: The first noun stays bare: *towuk çorbasy*, chicken soup. *Towugyň çorbasy* would be the soup of one particular chicken.

exercises.prompt: The kindergarten is next to the school.

exercises.text: Men bu türkmen haly___ gowy görýärin.
exercises.explain: *gowy görmek* takes the object in the accusative: *haly* + *-sy* (its) + *-ny* = *halysyny*.

accept: Does this bus go to the airport?
Is this bus going to the airport?

exercises.explain: *towuk çorbasy*, chicken soup, as a plain object with no ending.

accept: We live in the city of Ashgabat.
We are living in the city of Ashgabat.
